body_markdown:
This weekend, Mudrex brings you an exclusive opportunity to win big with an exclusive **6 months Paytm Premium subscription.** Invest $100 or more in any coin during the weekend and win an assured reward of Paytm Premium. 🌟


## ****Why should you buy now?****


Post halving dips are usually one of the best times to add crypto to your portfolio. Historically, the crypto market has gone through a minor dip before hitting new all-time highs following each halving. And experts predict that Bitcoin could even touch $100K soon.


And Mudrex’s weekend bonanza is the cherry on top of an already wonderful opportunity.


## ****How to participate?****


- **Eligibility:** Open only to Mudrex users in India.
- **Timing:** Starts at 12 AM on May 11th and ends at 11:59 PM on May 12th.
- **Requirement:** Invest at least $100 in any coin on Mudrex.


**NOTE:** The minimum investment amount should be $100. Rewards will be distributed to eligible users on **14th May 2024, Tuesday**


**More information about the reward:**


Paytm First is an exclusive membership gives you access to a wide range of benefits, including:


- Exclusive on the Paytm App.
- Premium Subscription to popular OTT, music, infotainment and wellness platforms.
- Offers on Brand Gift Cards purchased on the Paytm App.
- Exclusive offers and discounts on food, travel, and shopping brands & much more!


Don’t miss out. Invest now!


[Invest Now !](https://mudrexmobile.page.link/coins)
